categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily as a comprehensive security solutions provider with two main business segments: Security Services and Infrastructure Services. Security Services include physical security (system security, information security, IoT security) and security product sales. Infrastructure Services encompass real estate services (facility management, property management, consulting), integrated security, and security system integration (SI).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced security technologies such as AI-based facial recognition, intelligent video analytics, UWB radar intrusion detection, cloud-based access and attendance management, and integrated building management solutions. It develops proprietary hardware and software security solutions, including biometric authentication devices, thermal detection readers, and cloud-based monitoring platforms. The company does not engage in traditional manufacturing but focuses on technology development, system integration, and service delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include residential complexes, commercial buildings, large industrial facilities, government and defense sectors, and various industries requiring physical and information security. The company serves both B2B and B2C markets, including apartments, offices, R&D centers, logistics centers, and public institutions. It also targets emerging markets such as unmanned stores and remote work environments with specialized security solutions.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with a nationwide presence through multiple regional offices and service centers. It also has overseas subsidiaries and branches in China, Vietnam, and Hungary, targeting global security system integration markets and supporting Korean companies expanding abroad, including North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the downstream segment of the security industry supply chain, providing integrated security services, system integration, and facility management. It develops proprietary security technologies and solutions but does not manufacture raw materials or components. Its role includes technology development, service provision, system installation, monitoring, and maintenance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous innovation in AI, IoT, big data, and cloud technologies to enhance security and building management solutions. The company invests in R&D to develop advanced biometric devices, intelligent video analytics, and integrated cloud platforms. It focuses on expanding unmanned and contactless security solutions, smart building management, and safety monitoring systems to lead market trends and create new growth opportunities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through service contracts for security and facility management, sales of security products and solutions, system integration projects, and consulting services. The company also earns royalties from technology licensing agreements. Its revenue streams include recurring service fees, project-based income, and product sales to both public and private sector clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading market position in South Korea's security services and infrastructure management sectors, recognized for its brand power and service quality. It competes with other domestic and international security service providers and system integrators. Its competitive advantages include proprietary technology, extensive nationwide service network, and strong customer satisfaction evidenced by multiple industry awards and long-term market leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 2.62 trillion KRW with steady growth of 6.2% year-over-year. Operating profit was about 212.6 billion KRW, and net income increased by 25.5% to 189.5 billion KRW. Total assets stood at around 2.18 trillion KRW, reflecting a stable financial position with a debt-to-equity ratio of 36.4%. The company has demonstrated consistent profitability and moderate growth despite challenging economic conditions.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through integrated, technology-driven security and facility management solutions combining advanced AI, IoT, and cloud capabilities. It offers comprehensive, customized security services backed by proprietary technologies such as facial recognition and UWB radar intrusion detection. Its extensive nationwide infrastructure, professional service personnel, and continuous innovation enable superior service quality and customer trust, maintaining its status as a market leader with strong brand recognition.
